comment.body: Thanks for the detailed multi-monitor scenario. This request is already consolidated under #12584, the open tracker for controlling which monitor an application opens or restores on. The closely matching requests #12604 and #38574 were both closed by maintainers as duplicates of #12584, and #12604 specifically covers restoring a minimized window to a chosen screen. Please continue the use case on #12584 so the product decision stays in one place.
